deployments_detail.use: "AI Assistant" employee-manual gen AI (Azure OpenAI) voice/text auto-response across ~390 stores; vision AI for product recognition & label issuance
deployments_detail.value: ~390 stores; manuals of thousands-tens of thousands of pages

deployments_detail.use: 'AI Order' (AIオーダー) — demand-forecasting and automated ordering system that predicts customer demand from sales history, foot traffic, weather, price and promotions and calculates optimal order quantities for daily/perishable items. [IBM Japan]
deployments_detail.value: 50% reduction in ordering time, up to 40% better forecast accuracy, ~30% average inventory reduction; described as Japan's largest-scale demand forecasting/ordering system across ~380 stores

deployments_detail.use: 'AI Kakaku' (AIカカク) — AI dynamic markdown/discount pricing for perishable prepared foods, produce, meat and seafood; auto-generates optimal discount price labels to cut food waste. [IBM Japan]
deployments_detail.value: ~1,200 items across ~380 stores; expanded to livestock (May 2024) and seafood (May 2024) to reduce food loss

deployments_detail.use: In-store AI cameras for video analytics — crowd/customer counting and density monitoring, age estimation for alcohol-sale compliance (auto-notify cashier), and shopper behavior/heat-map analysis; integrated with Buddycom staff smartphones for instant voice notifications. [Fujitsu (GREENAGES Citywide Surveillance) + Buddycom]
deployments_detail.value: ~150 AI cameras per store across ~80 stores (Honshu/Shikoku); ~20,000 in-store smartphones with Buddycom; baby-goods pilot section saw sales 2.3x year-on-year

deployments_detail.use: Vision AI for self-service product recognition and label generation in bakery and sushi departments — camera identifies each bread/sushi item and auto-generates price labels (per-ingredient pricing for sushi), reducing manual input and enabling smoother self-checkout. [Viscovery (image-recognition AI)]
deployments_detail.value: ~90 bread varieties and ~50 sushi varieties recognized at AEON Tsudanuma South store (opened March 2026)

deployments_detail.use: Employee 'AI Assistant' — a generative-AI next-generation employee manual/chatbot that answers staff voice/text questions on service-counter and sales-floor procedures (Aeon Lounge, tax-free, lost & found, utility payments, shareholder benefits), built on an all-in-one device with single sign-on. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]
deployments_detail.value: Targets ~400 stores and ~100,000 employees; page describes pilot testing at select stores (not yet full rollout)

deployments_detail.use: 'exaBase generative AI' — enterprise ChatGPT-style assistant rolled out group-wide (led by Aeon Digital Academy) for store operations, HR, product development, market research, customer support, code generation (VBA/Python), document translation and agenda creation. [ExaWizards / Exa Enterprise AI (exaBase)]
deployments_detail.value: 90 companies and ~1,000 employees within ~3 months; top user (HR) saved 70 hours/month; HR dept saved ~130 hours/month

deployments_detail.use: 'User Local ChatAI' — secure RAG-enabled generative-AI chat platform for non-technical staff at HQ and stores, used to verify sales-promotion materials and generate internal inquiry responses from uploaded company documents. [User Local (ChatAI)]
deployments_detail.value: Adopted across 15+ Aeon group companies as of November 2025

deployments_detail.use: Agentic AI-assisted software development — Aeon Next uses GitHub Copilot Enterprise and the Copilot Coding Agent for platform engineering and automated code generation/PR merging. [GitHub Copilot Enterprise (Microsoft/GitHub)]
deployments_detail.value: Event talk by Masato Taruishi (Aeon Next) titled 'merged 30 PRs in half a day' using Copilot Coding Agent
